lines.2: Subaru, who had been at morning practice, was standing stunned at the edge of the field too.
lines.4: A battleship had smashed through the gym and come to rest wedged into the athletic field.
lines.7: 「I've never seen anyone come to challenge our dojo this brazenly.」
lines.8: 「I don't think this is a dojo challenge...」
lines.9: 「I absolutely cannot allow anyone to disrupt the other students' peaceful lives.」
lines.10: 「Hm...? Otome, someone's coming out of the ship.」
lines.13: The person who stepped off the ship was a girl so beautiful I couldn't help staring.
lines.14: Silver hair that fell past her waist.
lines.17: And a long sword nearly as tall as she was
lines.19: 「You there. Are you a student of Ryuumeikan?」
lines.20: Otome's clear voice rings across the schoolyard.
lines.23: 「Then I will have to use force.」
lines.25: The silver-haired girl answers as if she has just found her prey.
lines.28: Otome and the silver-haired girl must have collided, because an enormous shock wave erupts around them.
lines.29: In a single bound, Otome slips into the silver-haired girl's blind spot.
lines.31: A kick flashes out like lightning.
lines.33: 「No... That silver-haired girl jumped backward in an instant to soften the impact.」
lines.34: Sent flying by the kick, she plants one hand on the ground and deftly regains her footing.
lines.35: She gets up, casually patting the dust off her uniform. Just as Subaru said, she shows no sign of having taken any damage.
lines.36: 「Impossible! She took Kurogane's kick and she's still standing...」
lines.38: 「Date, who is that person fighting Kurogane?」
lines.40: 「A battleship crew member and an intruder.」
lines.43: 「Who's Enokida!? My name is Murata! Honestly... You people are impossible, never remembering my name...」
lines.44: 「Forget that. This next hit looks nasty.」
lines.46: 「Honestly, I didn't expect you to be this capable. I'm going to raise my attack power a little.」
lines.49: she closes the distance to the silver-haired intruder with the speed of a wild beast.
lines.53: A blast of wind far stronger than the last tears across the area.
lines.60: 「You're putting on quite a spectacle, but don't you think you've let the blood rush to your head, Otome?」
lines.62: 「I heard someone was holding her own against Otome. I see... so it was you.」
lines.63: 「Headmaster, forgive the abrupt question, but do you know this person?」
lines.64: 「Indeed. This girl is my elder brother's daughter--」
